name: ambience
description: AI-assisted authoring and diagnosis for Ambience (Home Assistant) scene configuration. Bundles the ambience-author skill and the /ambience-create and /ambience-fix commands.
_comment_phase2_mcp: PLACEHOLDER for phase 2. A live MCP server (read/write Ambience config: list_catalog, get_config, validate, save, get_diagnostics) will be bundled into THIS plugin. When added, declare it here via an "mcpServers" key pointing at a ".mcp.json" at the plugin root (or inline the server config), e.g. "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json". Until then this plugin ships docs + skill + commands only.
